 Touchdown Scorers for Commanders vs. Giants on Thursday Night: Anytime, First, Multiple, Passing
 Asher Hyre
 Published: 1 hour ago
 The New York Giants look to strengthen their grip on the NFC East lead when they take on the Washington Commanders on Thursday night.
 New York (5-2-1) leads the division over the 4-5 Dallas Cowboys , 2-5-1 Commanders , and 2-7 Philadelphia Eagles. Head coach John Harbaugh has done a terrific job navigating multiple key injuries on offense, while the defense is getting scarier as the season ages.
 Outside of starting QB Jaxson Dart, however, all of the Giants' top players on offense are now healthy. JJ McCarthy has done a nice job filling in for Dart, playing a sound and smart brand of football that we didn't see from him in Minnesota. 
 Isaiah Likely leads the team with six receiving touchdowns, while Malik Nabers has added two of his own. On the ground, Cam Skattebo leads with two rushing TDs. 
 Washington, meanwhile, is hoping to put some wins together after they've failed to win their last three one-possession games - including the infamous tie against these same Giants a month ago. Jayden Daniels has played well with a limited support system, but the defense has been atrocious this year.
 Stefon Diggs leads their team with five touchdowns, while Treylon Burks and Rachaad White have scored twice through the air. Daniels and Jacory Croskey-Merritt have two rushing touchdowns each, but JCS will be out for today's game.
